```{r Question1, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(easystats)
library(MASS)
library(caret)
library(broom)

dat = read.csv('FacultySalaries_1995.csv')

newdat = dat %>% 
  rename("Full" = "AvgFullProfSalary",
         "Assoc" = "AvgAssocProfSalary",
         "Assist" = "AvgAssistProfSalary") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Full", "Assoc", "Assist"),
               names_to = "Rank",
               values_to = "Salary")
```

## Question 1



```{r plot1, echo=FALSE}
newdat %>% 
  filter(!Tier %in% c("VIIB")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Rank,
             y = Salary,
             fill = Rank)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Tier) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red2", "green3", "lightblue3")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Rank",
    y = "Salary",
    fill = "Rank") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10))

```

## Question 2

```{r cleandata, echo=FALSE}

if (!"Tier" %in% names(newdat)) {
  newdat <- newdat %>%
    mutate(Tier = dat$Tier) 
}


mod1 <- aov(Salary ~ State + Tier + Rank, data = newdat)


summary(mod1)
```
## Question 3

```{r tidyjuniper, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results ='hide'}
juniper = read.csv("Juniper_Oils.csv")

newjun = juniper %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub("\\.", "-", .)) %>% 
  rename("compound 1" = "compound-1",
         "compound 2" = "compound-2") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("alpha-pinene","para-cymene","alpha-terpineol","cedr-9-ene","alpha-cedrene","beta-cedrene","cis-thujopsene","alpha-himachalene","beta-chamigrene","cuparene","compound 1","alpha-chamigrene","widdrol","cedrol","beta-acorenol","alpha-acorenol","gamma-eudesmol","beta-eudesmol","alpha-eudesmol","cedr-8-en-13-ol","cedr-8-en-15-ol","compound 2","thujopsenal"),
               names_to = "ChemicalID",
               values_to = "Mass_spec_conc")
```



## Question 4

```{r plot2, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
jun_plot = newjun %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = YearsSinceBurn, y = Mass_spec_conc)) +
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, color = "blue") +  
  facet_wrap(~ ChemicalID, scales = "free_y") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = "Years Since Burn", 
    y = "Concentration") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10), 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8), 
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"))

plot(jun_plot)
```


## Question 5


```{r glmmod, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Load required libraries
library(broom)

# Fit the generalized linear model
jun_glm <- glm(
  data = newjun,
  formula = Mass_spec_conc ~ ChemicalID * YearsSinceBurn,
  family = gaussian()
)

# Use `broom::tidy()` to extract model output
glm_results <- tidy(jun_glm)

# Filter for significant terms (p-value < 0.05)
significant_terms <- glm_results %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value)

# Display the significant terms
significant_terms
```
